==Info==
The Chop-Chop-Cups are smaller tournaments that take place in only one day.

*'''Season is over''' - 25 cups were played and thanks to everyone who joined!

==Format 1on1 ==
*'''Best of 1'''
*'''Maps'''
**One map per tournament
**Map rotate and change each tournament from a map pool.
**4 days each week on standard maps. 2 days on kenya.
**Standard maps: AEROWALK, ZTNDM3, DM4, BRAVADO
**Kenya maps: SKULL, SHIFTER, DM2, CATALYST, DM6
*'''Divisions'''
**Everyone start in a mixed bracket. 
**First round will function as a seeding of higher / lower div.
**Losing first match will put you in the lower bracket

==Format 2on2 ==
*'''Best of 3'''
*'''Map order'''
**One designated start map.
**Start map rotate each tournament between: DM4, DM2, AEROWALK
**After first match: loser drop a map, then winner drop one more map.
**Loser pick next map.
*'''Map pool'''
**'''AEROWALK, ZTNDM3, DM4, BRAVADO, DM2'''
*'''Divsions'''
**One start bracket with mixed divisions.
**First round is bo1 (all other rounds bo3) - losing the 1st match will put you in the "lower bracket", which will split the bracket into a "higher div / lower div"
